Голос — это образец: 10–20 секунд записи: A voice is a sample: 10–20 seconds of recording plus its exact transcript. A good sample is a single voice with no music or effects and an even delivery: if a calm line sits next to a shout, the synthesis jumps around. From one character it is better to make two voices, a calm one and an intense one. Make several variants from different parts of the recording and compare them on the test phrases: they can sound very different.
Аудио или видео (из видео берётся звук),: Audio or video (the audio track is used), up to 15 minutes and 512 MB. Select a segment on the waveform with the mouse and add it as a variant. Mouse wheel zooms, Shift + wheel scrolls, a click plays from that point.
<b>Расшифровка — слово в слово то, что з: The transcript must match the segment word for word: every word, repetition, “uh”, and a word cut off at the edge. Punctuation as you hear it: a comma at a pause, a full stop at the end of a sentence, “?” and “!” by intonation. Numbers and abbreviations as they are spoken: “twenty-five”, not “25”. A wrong transcript is the main cause of a bad voice: the synthesis starts swallowing words, repeating them or adding stray sounds. So cut the segment at pauses, with no word fragments at the edges.
«Убрать музыку» отделяет голос от музыки: “Remove music” separates the voice from music and sound effects (requires the “Remove music from samples” package); noise reduction then removes steady background noise and hiss. Processing can make the voice sound muffled or add artifacts — compare variants with and without it.
Фразы синтезируются при первом прослушив: Phrases are synthesized on first listen, with the same seed: variants differ only in the sample. Loudness is normalized, as with voice samples.
По одной на строку, до 8. Полезно взять: One per line, up to 8. It helps to use what chat usually writes on your channel.
